subject: EBP status: completion demo done, RNN sampler instability on point clouds
body:
Hi Alina, Lucia,

Where we are. The image-completion demo landed in April: MNIST digits conditioned on a subset of pixels, samples look clean, and the energy heatmaps (run_ebp.sh with -epoch_load on the last checkpoint) make a nice visual for the LRB deck.

Point clouds are harder. Denoising with the learned energy function works well on moderate noise - we're seeing roughly 30% Chamfer distance reduction against our partner-shaped test scans. But the RNN sampler for generation is training unstably: two of five seeds diverge after epoch 60, and the surviving runs are sensitive to the energy-function learning rate. I have a schedule of LR/regularization ablations queued, about ten days of Titan time.

Risk to flag: if the sampler doesn't stabilize by end of May, generation shouldn't go in the June LRB scope. Denoising alone is still a defensible launch story.

Katya
